claims.claim: Origen of Alexandria was a Greek‑speaking Christian theologian and head of the Catechetical School of Alexandria who later taught at Caesarea and was ordained a priest there.
He was born in Alexandria around AD 185 and died in Tyre around AD 254.
Origen composed these Psalms commentaries as homilies for the instruction of his catechumens and initiated listeners in Caesarea.
The fragments were quoted in later catenae and were also preserved in the newly discovered Greek manuscript Codex Graecus 314 (Munich), which contains 29 of Origen’s homilies on the Psalms.
SCOPE: this English is the Greek Psalm fragments stored for origen-psalms-fragments-greek, Psalms 1 through 22. Didymus's Commentarii in Psalmos and Fragmenta in Psalmos are different books.
